name: Latency against an SLO
blurb: A form whose inputs carry names for a host stylesheet, one of each input type.

inputs.label: Latencies
inputs.description:
Raw latencies, in the unit chosen below.
- **Spaces or commas**: `41 38 37 1450`.
- **One per line**: a column pasted from a spreadsheet.

A negative value is {bad|refused}. Zeros are {good|kept}, and {muted|blank lines are ignored}.

inputs.label: p99 target
inputs.details:
Compared with the p99 of what you paste, by nearest rank: the smallest value with at least 99% of them at or below it.
- A p99 equal to the target is a {bad|miss} only when the toggle below is on.
- With fewer than 100 values, the p99 is the {warn|largest} one.

{muted|A percentile of a few values says little.}

inputs.label: Count a value at the target as a miss
